Canonical RREF enumeration covers all 417199 subspaces of \(\mathbb F_2^8\), with per-dimension totals verified against Gaussian binomial coefficients. Direct support unions and the orthogonal column-section calculation independently agree on all four hierarchy vectors and all four minimizer-count vectors. The finite claim makes no inference beyond these four representatives.

originality.rationale: The primary source supplies the four generator matrices and their ordinary minimum distances but does not state higher generalized Hamming weights or minimizer multiplicities. Exact searches for the four parameter sets together with “generalized Hamming weights”, “weight hierarchy”, “support hierarchy”, and multiplicity language returned no same-object coverage. The closest 2026 self-orthogonal hierarchy paper treats different defining-set families, while the exact optimal-code tables of Kurz–Landjev–Rousseva stop at binary dimension seven. A general GHW algorithm does not imply the four numerical profiles. The accepted statement is therefore a new code-specific complete support profile on the checked literature, with the residual risk of unindexed computations explicitly retained.

value.rationale: The four source codes are not arbitrary slices: they are exactly the four new dimension-eight self-orthogonal record representatives used by the primary paper to close previously unknown ordinary minimum-distance entries. Generalized Hamming weights measure support growth of higher-dimensional subcodes and are an established structural invariant for self-orthogonal codes. Determining the complete hierarchy extends each record from its first weight to all eight support levels, while the exact minimizer multiplicities give a finer incidence statistic not determined by the hierarchy alone. The calculation is therefore a natural, complete finite classification attached to four newly introduced extremal objects rather than a routine recomputation of a known table.
